title: Earl Hines and Chicago piano
summary: Ashcraft calls Hines possibly the greatest pianist and describes his right hand, vibrato, tenths and Jimmy Johnson bass.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Who played piano: the pianists musicians remembered
